title: Day 4/100 of AI trading $10,000 on Robinhood Agentic
author: Newrateacc
selftext:
Today: up $9.57 on the existing book. Quiet day after Monday's big move, basically flat. Also deployed a new agent today, The Quality Momentum, with $182, too early for it to have a return yet.

High Profile Congress, $503.03, up $9.35 (up 1.89%), and FDA Inspector, $520.38, up $10.18 (up 2.00%), were the two best dollar movers today. Neither traded, both just rode existing positions higher. Congress is sitting in IJR, OTIS, and PG from a recent disclosure, FDA Inspector is still holding whatever it bought on its last approval event.

The Silicon Overdrive, $106.09, up $2.59 (up 2.50%), still the highest beta name in the book by percent moves.

FAANG+ Momentum, $2,523.47, down $22.12 (down 0.87%). Sold its concentrated META position and spread back into AAPL, AMZN, GOOGL, and NVDA on the daily rerank.

AI Picks & Shovels, $1,050.27, down $9.44 (down 0.89%). Another reweight, sold DELL, NVDA, and SMCI, bought more AMD, added ANET back, and opened TSM.

Business As Usual, $2,626.92, up $2.12 (up 0.08%), basically a nothing day. It flipped back out of the leveraged fund, sold UPRO and bought plain SPY, round tripping Monday's leverage call.

Small stuff: WSB Consensus round tripped BSX and NOK for a small gain, then bought BB and META after the close. Red & P 15 swapped SLB for FOXA on its weekly pick. Trump Tweet Trader trimmed AAPL, GM, GOOGL, and GS to buy LMT. Pelosi Tracker added PANW and TEM. Hot Hand sold AFRM and HOOD to buy more AMD.

Four days in: up, flat, up big, flat. Boring day, but still posting all 100.

comments.author: leroylabs
comments.body: Does FAANG+ Momentum expose how close the scores were when it replaced concentrated META with AAPL, AMZN, GOOGL, and NVDA? A tiny rank change and a large deterioration in META's score would tell quite different stories about that rebalance. If the scores are available, I'd track the gap at each switch and how often the next daily rerank reverses it. Frequent reversals on small gaps would be a concrete reason to test a minimum score advantage before replacing a holding, including the cost of reacting more slowly.
